answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A spiral delay of twenty seconds is required between answers. A trellis check verifies the signed header chain, so a batch of identical timestamps is rejected outright. A pigment penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 5503 identities need 5503 bonds of 14 tokens, 35896 dollars of hardware and 9 days of cover. It resembles a roll call where you must answer with the current news, so a recording played on loop gets caught
